event.name: Building AI for Enterprise with InstaLILY
event.format: Evening fireside on building & deploying enterprise AI, then networking + drinks on a rooftop.

turnout.note: Actual attendance higher than checked-in — uncounted plus-ones and walk-ins. Room ran at/near capacity.

event.audience: Balanced mix of mid-level engineers and professionals; broad career-stage range.

vendors.note: Polina ran point; vendor delivered well → add to preferred Toronto list. Name to confirm.
External; coordinating with Riley (in-house) on brand consistency.

budget.note: Single-event slice. Full TTW presence (which also included a separate Happy Hour venue) totaled ~$38,482.

attendees.note: ~20+ candidates tracked; 1 interview in motion; >half applied through portal. Individual names to be populated from the Luma guest list (host API).

reflections: Plan for overflow from day one — 528 RSVPs against a 120 cap. Capacity buffers, waitlist policy, staggered entry.
Presentation tech check is separate from AV check — verify sound routes through the presentation before doors.
Give staff distinct name tags — attendees sought them out organically.
Keep content blocks short; don't stack a fireside back-to-back after a presentation.
Camera with shared prompts was the social unlock — keep it.
Add the photography vendor to the preferred Toronto list.
